account: In an August 2026 interview published by Civic, caseworkers Danielle Leahy and Claudia Runk from Representative Seth Moulton’s office described their role in developing Revere. They reported that the platform displayed casework patterns automatically and made it easier to reopen cases while keeping their history. They described reduced mental effort and time demands, without a measured time comparison. Civic’s current product page identifies AI-supported tagging, clustering, urgent-case flagging, and retrieval over office records. The staff interview concerns the full workflow, including conventional software features, and does not isolate AI’s contribution.

ai_role.statement: Civic describes AI classification and retrieval within Revere. The reported improvements concern the wider software workflow; the interview does not establish which benefits require AI.

fields.account: In an August 2026 interview published by Civic, caseworkers Danielle Leahy and Claudia Runk from Representative Seth Moulton’s office described their role in developing Revere. They reported that the platform displayed casework patterns automatically and made it easier to reopen cases while keeping their history. They described reduced mental effort and time demands, without a measured time comparison. Civic’s current product page identifies AI-supported tagging, clustering, urgent-case flagging, and retrieval over office records. The staff interview concerns the full workflow, including conventional software features, and does not isolate AI’s contribution.
